title: Battery Stock and Device Drain
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level category=batteries
| stats latest(level_pct) as stock, avg(monthly_use) as usage by battery_type
| eval months_left=round(stock/usage,1)
| sort months_left
description: Tracks your household battery stock against how fast devices drain them, so you are never caught without.
value: A battery drawer runs dry at the worst moment; a stock-versus-usage view keeps the common sizes topped up.
implementation: Log battery stock and usage into `index=personal`; flag types running low.
visualization: Table of battery types by months of stock left.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your spare batteries against how fast you use them, so the drawer is never empty when you need one.
